name: Azure
description:
Builds and runs a team's own Azure resources, signed in as the person: resource groups, Bicep and ARM deployments checked by what-if first, registry builds, Azure SQL databases and SQL, storage blobs, tables and queues, Key Vault, Container Apps with their logs and custom domains, DNS zones, budgets and role assignments for its managed identities.

It changes only what it created, which carries the tags yawble-owner and yawble-plugin, plus the shared SQL servers and registries a person lists. It acts with the person's own Azure rights, never more. What-if by default: every changing command says what it would do and changes nothing until a person sets mode to apply. It never reads a key, a connection string or a secret value, and no token reaches its output.

subscription.description: The id of the Azure subscription this member works in, such as 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000; run setup after signing in and it lists the subscriptions your account can read.

regions.description: The Azure regions resource groups may be created in, by name, such as westeurope or eastus2.

mode.description: whatif answers what each changing command would do and changes nothing in Azure; apply makes the changes.

allowDelete.description: Off: every delete is refused, in whatif and apply; on: the member may delete what its team owns.

sharedSqlServers.description: Existing SQL servers, by name such as my-sql-server, on which the member may create its own databases; it never changes the server or another database on it.

sharedRegistries.description: Existing container registries, by name such as myregistry, the member may build and push images to and grant pull rights on to its own managed identities.

monthlyBudget.description: A monthly budget, in the subscription's currency, put on every resource group the member creates, with alerts at 80% and 100%; 0 means no budget.

budgetEmails.description: The email addresses the budget alerts go to; needed when monthlyBudget is more than 0.

namePrefix.description: Text put before the name of every resource group the member creates, such as team1-; empty by default.

microsoft.description: The Microsoft account that signs in to Azure; the member acts with that account's own Azure rights.

publishes.summary: What a changing command would do, or what a deployment's what-if found: counts by change type and any refusals.

fields.name: command

fields.name: target
fields.summary: The resource group or resource id it acts on.

fields.summary: What it would do, in words.

fields.name: unchanged
fields.summary: Resources a deployment leaves as they are.

fields.name: refusals
fields.summary: Each change refused, naming its resource; empty when none.
